wsjHeadlines.title: Stock Market Today: Bond Yields Jump as Oil Climbs
wsjHeadlines.description: Brent crude moves about $105 a barrel; stocks fall

wsjHeadlines.title: What to Know About Anthropic’s Planned IPO
wsjHeadlines.description: The artificial-intelligence giant has yet to officially launch its listing.

wsjHeadlines.title: The Relentless Crypto Billionaire Who Moved to Venezuela in Pursuit of Oil
wsjHeadlines.description: Fred Ehrsam, a Trump administration ally and co-founder of Coinbase, lived for months in a luxury Caracas hotel pursuing investments in Venezuela.

wsjHeadlines.title: The Unrelenting Bond Selloff Puts the 10-Year Yield on the Cusp of 5%
wsjHeadlines.description: Rising borrowing costs threaten to disrupt the stock market and slow the economy.

wsjHeadlines.title: U.S. 10-Year Treasury Yield Nears 5% as Oil Fuels Inflation Fears
wsjHeadlines.description: Oil prices topped $102 a barrel in the U.S. and global benchmark Brent hit $107, fueling a global bond market sell off Thursday.

wsjHeadlines.title: Bonds Sell Off Despite Buyback Operation
wsjHeadlines.description: Plus, oil prices surge above $107 a barrel and wholesale inflation picks up.

wsjHeadlines.title: Brooks Automation Files Confidentially for IPO
wsjHeadlines.description: Private-equity firm THL owns the company.

wsjHeadlines.title: The IPO That Asks You to Buy AI Hype Today and Get Paid Years Later
wsjHeadlines.description: SB Energy’s offering features $430 billion in data-center deals, no operating sites and a clause giving OpenAI free rent for delays.

wsjHeadlines.title: The High-Stakes Gamble Playing Out in the Natural-Gas Market
wsjHeadlines.description: Europe has stockpiled only enough natural gas to get through a mild winter.

wsjHeadlines.title: AI Is Disrupting Software Companies—but Not as Fast as Many Feared
wsjHeadlines.description: Even as their shares got pummeled, companies like Salesforce and Workday have been showing financial strength.

wsjHeadlines.title: Hermès Has Big Watchmaking Ambitions. The Cult of the Birkin Is Getting in the Way.
wsjHeadlines.description: Many people only buy the brand’s watches to boost their chances of getting a handbag.

wsjHeadlines.title: The Cancer Vaccine Gold Rush Has Begun. So Has the Race for Picks and Shovels.

wsjHeadlines.description: Rogo, which recently signed a new round of strategic investments, is already used by major investment banks.

wsjHeadlines.description: The financial technology company is seeking to establish a federally regulated, uninsured national trust bank called Builders Bank & Trust.

wsjHeadlines.description: Florida-based EverBank Financial has reached a deal to pursue a reverse merger with the smaller bank in the Pacific Northwest.

wsjHeadlines.description: Illicit Iranian funds are flowing through U.S.-dollar clearing accounts, creating an enforcement dilemma for Washington.

wsjHeadlines.title: U.S. Stocks Fall as Oil Tops $100, Yields Hit Multiyear Highs
wsjHeadlines.description: U.S. stocks fell for the fourth straight session and Treasury yields hit multiyear highs as U.S. oil prices topped the $100-per-barrel level, while August inflation data revealed the toll energy costs are taking on commercial users.

wsjHeadlines.title: Regulatory Uncertainty Clouds Chinese Robot Firm Galaxea AI’s IPO Plan
wsjHeadlines.description: A tighter regulatory climate in China is casting a cloud over robotics startup Galaxea AI’s plan to go public in Hong Kong, people familiar with the matter say.

wsjHeadlines.title: European Stock Indexes Edge Higher, Tech Stocks Fall
wsjHeadlines.description: European stock indexes largely edged higher after falling sharply in the last session.

wsjHeadlines.title: Bank of Korea Warns of Destabilizing Impact of High-Risk AI Trades
wsjHeadlines.description: A surge of investment in leveraged exchange-traded funds generated significant volatility in the domestic stock market, the Bank of Korea said.

wsjHeadlines.title: U.S. Stocks Fall as War Escalation, Oil Spike Continue
wsjHeadlines.description: U.S. stocks extended their recent decline as the war in the Middle East continued to escalate and drive up oil prices.

wsjHeadlines.title: Opinion | The SEC Unmuzzles Jamie Dimon
wsjHeadlines.description: The agency rescinds an Obama-era rule that limited political speech.

wsjHeadlines.title: Opinion | How to Make Life Hard for Small Banks
wsjHeadlines.description: The CECL accounting standard is costly and counterproductive.

wsjHeadlines.title: Opinion | What if California Becomes a ‘Failed State’?
wsjHeadlines.description: ‘Political risk,’ usually the precinct of Third World despotisms, could soon be a concern for U.S. locales.

wsjHeadlines.title: Opinion | BlackRock Casts a Vote of Confidence in Texas
wsjHeadlines.description: The former champion of ESG now backs corporate proposals to reincorporate in the Lone Star State.

wsjHeadlines.title: Opinion | A Return to Sound Money Will Fix Inflation
wsjHeadlines.description: Interest-rate adjustments aren’t enough. The U.S. must restore a gold-backed dollar.

wsjHeadlines.description: Higher yields aren’t yet a crisis. They could be if the politicians in Washington don’t listen.

wsjHeadlines.title: Tight Supply Worries Lift Oil As Middle East Conflict Heats Up
wsjHeadlines.description: Oil futures rose to their highest level in nearly four months with increased fighting across the Persian Gulf region raising supply worries.

wsjHeadlines.title: U.S. Natural Gas Futures Edge Higher
wsjHeadlines.description: U.S. natural gas futures settled modestly higher after the EIA reported a fourth straight below-average weekly storage build, although the 40 Bcf injection landed above market expectations.

wsjHeadlines.title: Gold Settles Lower as U.S. Producer Prices Pick Up
wsjHeadlines.description: Gold futures lost ground as a pickup in U.S. producer price inflation in August raised expectations of a Fed rate increase next week.

wsjHeadlines.title: U.S. Crude Oil Stockpiles Fall, Production Hits Record
wsjHeadlines.description: Commercial crude oil stocks fell by 391,000 barrels last week. Analysts had expected crude stocks to fall by 1.4 million barrels.

wsjHeadlines.title: WSJ Dollar Index Rises 0.35% to 95.18
wsjHeadlines.description: The WSJ Dollar Index rose 0.4%, snapping a three-trading-day losing streak.

wsjHeadlines.title: Bank of Japan Tightening Bets, U.S. Pressure Spark Yen Recovery
wsjHeadlines.description: Just over a month after joint currency interventions failed to pull the yen significantly off multi-decade lows, shifting policy expectations have triggered a remarkable turnaround.
